color.summary: Neutral greys with no tint: a #f1f1f1 page, white cards, menus and modals, #303030 ink and #616161 for secondary text, #e3e3e3 for borders and tracks. The primary button is near-black (#303030), not a brand color; blue (#005bd3) is kept for links and focus. Status colors come as pale fills with dark ink (critical #fed1d7 on #8e0b21) and solid banner headers (warning #ffb800, info #91d0ff). Dark is Polaris's dark-experimental theme: a #1a1a1a page, #303030 surfaces and #e3e3e3 ink, with the primary button flipped to white.
missing: dark-experimental leaves navigation, fields, badges and banners on their light values, so some dark copies read light-on-light.

type.summary: Inter throughout at 13px on a 20px line, weight 450 for body, buttons and fields; 12px on a 16px line for small text. Emphasis uses 550 and 650 rather than 500 and 600. Headings are tight and bold: 20px/24 at 700 with -0.2px tracking, up to 36px/48 at 700 for display.

shape.summary: 8px corners on buttons, nav rows, tabs and menu rows; 12px on cards, banners, popovers and tooltips' surfaces; 16px on the modal; 4px on keyboard keys. Switches are full pills.

spacing.summary: Compact, on a 2px grid: 8px is by far the most common gap, then 12px, 6px and 4px. Controls are 28px (buttons, tabs, nav rows) and 32px (fields, menu rows).

elevation.summary: Polaris bevels instead of shadowing: buttons carry an inset bottom shade, a 1px inner ring and a 0.5px top highlight, and pressing swaps it for an inset shade along the top. Cards and banners sit on a single 1px drop (#1a1a1a at 7%); popovers and the modal float on soft drops up to 20px.

button.summary: Polaris's Button: 28px, 12px padding, 13px at 450, 8px corners and the bevel. Variants are primary (near-black with a gradient and dark bevel), secondary (white with a grey bevel, the default), tertiary (no frame until hover), plain (blue text) and a critical tone (red #c70a24 with a red bevel). Icon-only buttons are 28px squares.

pressable.note: A class every Polaris button carries, not a variant: the capture grouped primary, secondary, tertiary, plain and critical under it. The tile is secondary, on the dark sheet.

v-rhyi8n.note: The dismiss × on the dark #1a1a1a toast.

usage: Pressed buttons swap the bevel for an inset shade and darken; focus adds a 2px #005bd3 ring 1px outside.
missing: The variants aren't split: the shared class pressable names them all, so primary, tertiary, plain and critical have no tiles of their own yet.
The live Shopify Admin (signed in) awaits the local capture; these are Polaris React 13.9.5 in a harness.

segmented-control.summary: Polaris has no segmented control: a segmented ButtonGroup stands in. Its buttons are secondary buttons joined edge to edge; the chosen one is pressed into a grey (#cccccc) fill with an inset shade.

pressable.note: Day, Week, Month: white with the grey bevel.
